gloss: inferiority; disadvantage; being at a disadvantage

definitions.explanation: a position of weakness or disadvantage compared to an opponent or competitor

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{劣勢|れっせい}だった。
examples.english: We were at a disadvantage in the match.
We were put at a numerical disadvantage.

examples.japanese: {劣勢|れっせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挽回|ばんかい}→挽回：16313_bankai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: We recovered from the disadvantage and won.
